modification_description: Make the education/conversation step conditional on safety and feasibility rather than a default second phase. Add an intermediate escalation option for larger or persistent hazards: alert campground staff or rangers instead of (or in addition to) engaging the camper directly. The revised sequence is: (1) immediately mitigate highest-risk litter safely using leave-no-trace practices; (2) if the hazard is large, persistent, or the situation feels unsafe, escalate to staff/rangers for enforcement; (3) only engage the camper in gentle education if it is safe and practical to do so, using a brief, low-shame, assistance-framed approach.
